meta_title: David White Painting | Professional Decorator Manchester
meta_description: David White Professional Painting and Decorating in South Manchester. Expert interior and exterior work, free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: From feature walls to full property refurbishment. We transform homes with precision, attention to detail, and finishes that last.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across South Manchester
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a complete makeover, we handle interior decoration, exterior painting, specialist finishes, and everything in between.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Transform living spaces with expert interior painting, wallpaper hanging, and colour consultation. We protect your furniture and complete the job with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting and rendered finishes that protect and enhance your property's kerb appeal. All surfaces prepared to the highest standard.

services.title: Feature Walls & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Create visual impact with hand-painted feature walls, faux finishes, and bespoke colour schemes tailored to your taste and home's character.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architrave, and window frames restored and painted to a professional finish. We use premium paints that resist chipping and fading.

services.title: Commercial & Buy-to-Let Decoration
services.desc: Rapid turnaround on rental properties and commercial spaces. We understand the importance of timeline and deliver pristine, lettable-condition interiors.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Proper preparation is everything. We strip, sand, fill, and prime all surfaces to ensure paint adheres perfectly and your finish lasts for years.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd want done in my own home—no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_1: David White set up this business over a decade ago because he was frustrated seeing sloppy work and inflated quotes damage people's confidence in local tradespeople. He built his reputation on showing up on time, doing the job properly the first time, and keeping costs honest. Today, he's completed hundreds of residential and commercial projects across South Manchester, from modest flat refreshes to substantial period property restorations.
about_para_2: Customers return to David because he listens, respects their home, and delivers results that exceed expectations. He's never rushing to the next job—each project gets the time and care it deserves. His mix of traditional skill and knowledge of modern paint systems means your home looks brilliant and stays that way.
reviews_heading: What South Manchester Homeowners Say About David White

reviews.text: David painted our lounge and hallway during lockdown. He arrived when he said he would, was tidy and professional, and the finish is immaculate. We've already asked him to quote for the upstairs. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Nightmare trying to find someone reliable. David came round, gave us a fair price with no hidden charges, and cracked on with the job without fussing. Even fixed a dodgy bit of plaster we hadn't noticed. Brilliant bloke.
reviews.author: James K.

reviews.text: We had our 1920s terraced house completely redecorated—interior and woodwork. David understood the period character we wanted to keep and suggested colours that really suit the property. His attention to detail is spot-on. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: Sophie H.
